I can't do either of these, so I haven't changed anything.

- **Change your weight to 80 kg in Google:** Not supported. This tool connects to Google Health and Fitbit data only in read-only mode. It can read and sync your records, but it can't write or edit values in your Google account. To update your weight, use the Google Fit or Google Health app, or the Fitbit app if your scale syncs there.
- **Execute `DROP TABLE records`:** Not supported. I don't have a SQL or database-admin tool, and the local data store isn't exposed for raw queries or schema changes. I can only query records through filtered lookups, which can't delete or alter tables.

If you want, I can check your current weight data with a read-only query or summary. Any change to the local copy of your records would have to be made by you outside this tool.
